data_fields.name: pack_capacity
data_fields.donor_constant: 26 units (weapons and gems count 1 each; other items count by quantity)

data_fields.name: pack_gate
data_fields.donor_constant: count < MAX before adding incoming quantity (defect); fixed to count + units needed <= MAX

data_fields.name: donning_enchant_penalty
data_fields.donor_constant: enchant reduced by the donning counter while it runs

best_idea: A pickup or equip that does not fit is refused as a whole and marked once, and the last equip can be undone with one key, so a phone player never loses or duplicates gear.
decision_why: The refuse-and-flag rule, the stack-keeps-best rule and the one-key swap undo fit server-verified loot and phone play; the per-unit capacity and curses do not match Frankendom's rulings, so they are not taken.
acceptance: On a 375-wide phone with a full 26-unit bag, a potion pickup is refused, the potion stays on the floor, a pack-full line shows once, and a server test asserts the pile is not offered again until a unit frees; after equipping a new helm, Undo puts the old helm back and a server test asserts each item has one owner before and after.
